reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (OVER-CONSTRAINED): 35ae2e259e4.c (Apache mod_ssl). Same bug as TRANSFORMATION_85 — 'eckey could be null (null value from malloc) and is dereferenced' at line 17 ('*eckey = 15'). The null dereference after unguarded malloc at line 10 is real when HAVE_ECC=true AND NOT SSL_CTX_set_ecdh_auto. OVER-CONSTRAINED: this PC instance additionally requires __USE_EXTERN_INLINES=true, which is a stdlib header guard desugaring artifact. The correct condition is just HAVE_ECC=true AND NOT SSL_CTX_set_ecdh_auto — requiring __USE_EXTERN_INLINES=true makes the PC too narrow (excludes __USE_EXTERN_INLINES=false cases where the same bug also exists). Compare with T85 which covered all __STRICT_ANSI__/USE_EXTERN_INLINES combinations and was correctly constrained.
